name: p8d8
assumptions: 64 GPUs; each worker uses TP4 and EP4; every P and D GPU is included in the denominator.
The shared V10 AIC calibration is a candidate until its full hardware matrix passes; no hardware validation exists for 64 GPUs or disaggregated RR.
Prefill cache capacity is assumed equal to the observed aggregate allocation: 443697 attention pages and 769 recurrent states. Prefill startup logs are unavailable.
Decode uses 809406 observed attention pages and 64 private state/request slots inferred from the resolved SGLang defaults.
Per-rank handoff timing assumes 64 GB/s, the native Mocker default. It is not a measured Mooncake rate. A handoff moves 3072 bytes per input token plus 101990400 recurrent-state bytes per rank.
Independent handoff delays do not model contention on a shared NIC. Check demanded bandwidth and rerun finalists at 20 and 100 GB/s; placement within the NVLink domain is not established.
AIPerf retains the 393-root dataset, seed42, 25-75 percent sampled starts, warmup, one-hour wall-clock profile, 60s grace, and 1200s request timeout.
Frontend router mode applies to both P and D routing. KV comparisons measure cache-aware routing; prefix caching remains enabled for RR on aggregate/P workers.
